six_patches.readback: Both verify and seaweedfs_patches completed successfully; workflow conclusion success.

verified_contracts: Real SDK v2 JSON serialization, SigV4/service/region signing and session token with synthetic HTTP; no AWS account or target contacted
GenerateDataKey AES_256 and encryption context; standardized ciphertext envelope byte equality
Decrypt of previously stored envelope; alias resolution and DescribeKey metadata
Nine provider error codes including wrapped Smithy API errors retain SeaweedFS mapping
One SDK attempt for ambiguous GenerateDataKey HTTP500 and transport failures; cancelled request produces no transport call
Static credentials/session precedence, environment fallback and explicit shared profile fixture
Explicit region; partial or orphan static credentials and unsupported role/external ID fields denied
Implicit KMS/global endpoint overrides denied; explicit endpoint precedence and malformed URL rejection
Connect/request timeouts default10/30s and explicit7/19s; negative/overflow durations and nonzero max_retries rejected
Nil/invalid request and envelope validation before I/O; missing metadata rejected
normative_sources_consulted: docs/OUF_RESILIENCE_POLICY.md v3 rules1-10,governed recovery and qualification criteria
intentional_configuration_changes: Region is now mandatory rather than silently us-east-1.
max_retries must be zero/absent: previous default3 internal retries replaced by one attempt; owner recovery not implemented by this patch.
connect_timeout now actually configures the dialer; previously read but unused.
role_arn/external_id previously ignored now rejected; shared-profile role configuration remains a distinct binding requiring qualification.
Default SDK v2 chain can differ from v1 and is not a qualification of production credentials.
limitations: Only synthetic HTTP transport and local credential fixtures; no live KMS/SSE or target acceptance.
SDK v2 KMS adds four compiled packages and upgrades four shared modules; go.mod/go.sum changes are intentional. Full new SBOM/security/licence/custody/cohort qualification remains OPEN.
Explicit HTTP endpoint remains available for isolated LocalStack compatibility; target TLS/egress allowlisting is separately required.
SDK default chain including roles/process/SSO/external identity endpoints and refresh needs binding/authority qualification.
One SDK attempt plus inherited error conversion does not implement durable retry, ambiguity reconciliation or preserve cancellation as a typed domain cause.
Historical envelope/provider behavior remains; no redesign of key identity validation or provider response policy.
SDK v1 remains in three S3 clients and S3 request parser/helpers.
No target operation, object copy, replay/reset/grant, merge/deploy, admission or release acceptance.
Scope17 consumed/52EngineGET,Teatri M1 and same Farmacie61rows/10OPEN/STRING remain preserved.
